comment: Dr. Boland is so nice and neuro was a really fascinating class. It was one of the hardest bio classes I've taken here, as she has a hard time trimming down material in her lectures (she loves to talk) and the exams were VERY challenging. That being said I think I grew as a student in this class and I'm really glad I took it.

Dr. Boland was a fair grader and always gave us opportunities to see her outside of class. For papers, she let us pick our topics and always met with us so we could get feedback before turning in our final draft. The discussions were also easy, most of the time you didn't even have to read everything, but sometimes she would take over the talk.

Dr. Boland clearly is passionate about working with students. For every major paper, students met with her and were able to receive feedback before turning in the final copy. She allows for student choice and is respectful of different opinions (this specific class was discussion based).

Always complained about how busy she was and never seemed to have time for us. Goes on about things that don't matter. Her grading did not make sense. All we did was discuss the same things over and over.

Dr. Boland has certainly changed from when she started. She is very thorough in her lectures although sometimes too thorough where she starts rambling. However, she's almost always very nice to the students, and she cares about them as long as you are diligent in your work. Can be tough sometimes but means well and gives really good feedback.

I agree that she has changed! I was so scared going to my first class with her, but she is actually really helpful & nice. She posts all her powerpoints on blackboard & gives you a ton of opportunities to get extra credit. Her tests are about as difficult as you would expect cell bio to be, but as long as you study you should do well.

She's changed guys! Don't worry! I put minimal effort into her class and I am hoping to get an A+! It was a great semester. I strongly encourage you to take her class if you can. I rated her "extremely helpful", but actually, I've never asked for help...because I didn't need it! Additionally, she is an enjoyable person and dresses nicely!
The worst teacher I had at Richmond.  She ruined biology for me so much that I dropped it as a major. DO NOT TAKE HER!!!

SHE SUCKS She is trying to teach beyond her knowledge. I DO NOT RECOMMEND HER AT ALL
SHE SUCKS. DO NOT TAKE HER UNLESS YOU WANT TO DIE!!! SHE CAN NOT ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS.. ALL SHE SAY IS "GOOD QUESTION I DO NOT KNOW THE ANSWER" SHE SUCKS

cell molec- DO NOT TAKE HER! she is extremely confusing, her tests are impossible and extremely unfair; i made appointments to see her 3 different times and all three times she wasn't there. she favors students and then dislikes the rest. she is so unhelpful and very unfair. her lectures make no sense and she rambles on about nothing importantavoid

Tries to teach material far beyond what's in the book but is the most unclear professor I've ever had.  She gives out her lecture notes but they consist of endless pictures of cells with no explanation as to what they represent.  This is the most frustrating class I've taken at Richmond.

This is by far the worst teacher ive had at UR. She teaches things that no other classes are learning in an attempt to "further your education" when in reality all she is furthering is students confusion.

she is probably one of the worst professors i've ever had at this university. she teaches my major and because of her i'm losing interest in it! every day she goes on about her pretty pictures and teaches nothing relevant to the material that we're supposed to be learning.
It's true; she goes on and on and on about the most unnecessary things, instead of getting to the point.

she gets a bad wrap from students who are whiny panzies...over all she is a good teacher but a little confusing, if you go talk to her after class she will help you understand the material. also reading helps!!! instead of just relying on notes (like everyone else). basicaly a regular average teacher, nothing special here.
Boland's tests are really hard and in class she goes on and on talking about something forever instead of reinforcing the basic essential ideas.  Not recommended.

The most boring class I have ever taken. Unclear notes. Does not give any typed notes, simply shows pictures and talks without end about them. tries to have help sessions but they arent any more helpful. dont take her if you can help it!

I can tell she's trying.  She puts a lot of effort into her lectures, but for some reason, nothing clicks.  She is eager to help students who come to her, but I agree that you pretty much have to teach yourself the material.  AND BRING STARBUCKS TO CLASS OR ELSE YOU WILL FALL ASLEEP!!!

Awful awful teacher!  Lectures are boring and unorganized and the classes go on forever.  Tests are hard and don't make sense.  I haven't learned anything in this class.  Stay away from her at all costs!

She's unclear and can't answer many of the questions that come up.  Tests are awful and it doesn't appear she cares very much about her students at all

She is very unhelpful. In her lectures she tends to ramble and not about anything helpful.
She was very unclear and did not test on what she emphasized in class. She does not seem to care about how people do in her class.

Hard to know what all she is expecting on her tests and lots of information to retain. Not very approachable and still acts like she's teaching med school. Ok, but be prepared to teach yourself a lot of the material that's covered on the tests.

However, she is accessible and willing to help if needed.  Prepares students for tests and what to expect so there aren't many surprises. Overall ok.
